title: Project AXILLARY remote-controlled aircraft (CIA history, Appendix E, p. 342)
description: Photograph of a small high-wing glider-based model aircraft with a boom tail and a pod-mounted engine, shown from the front quarter against a dark background. The caption reads "Project AXILLARY." Text describes the "Miniature Multi-Purpose Airborne Vehicle" built from a Hawk-750 glider kit under contract with Melpar, Inc., with a portion of the text redacted.
